assumptions.independent_world: Two independently sampled uniform ideal functions, one per purpose.
assumptions.input_choice: Two fixed non-adaptive classical queries; an equality test on the outputs.
assumptions.range_choice: An explicit hypothetical M, never inferred from a native hash representation.
assumptions.shared_world: One uniformly sampled ideal function; both interfaces use it.

next_obligations: Specify the actual joint encoded-input family and identify every domain intersection.
Prove a compatible single-oracle emulation/reduction, or prove disjoint domains for every interface where independent functions are invoked in a theorem.
Account for extraction, Fiat-Shamir and all other exposed uses in that same model.
Establish whether any exhibited encoding intersection is reachable under the fixed accepted proof relation before making an implementation security claim.

scope.positive_control_scope: Distinct inputs concern only this fixed two-query experiment; they do not prove global domain separation of a program.
